schoolName: Macau University of Science and Technology Faculty of Medicine
reviewNotes: HOLD — MUST offers an active English-taught six-year MBBS. Its current 2026/27 non-Macao-resident fee table lists HKD 258,000 for the first year, including clinical-internship tuition, and its official admissions system documents direct admission for international applicants plus MBBS-specific interview requirements. A June 2026 official news post records the second MBBS graduating cohort. Despite strong course, fee and admissions evidence, this pass did not establish a current independent programme accreditation/recognition record, complete local licensing pathway, MBBS-specific international accommodation/insurance evidence, or a fully evidenced clinical-placement contract packet. Keep it held until these requirements are verified; do not imply global or Indian recognition.
